name: dumbbell-high-low-carry
instructions:
1. Grasp a dumbbell in each hand using a neutral grip and stand up straight.
2. Clean and press one of the dumbbells overhead and hold the other by your side to get into position.
3. While maintaining an active shoulder position, maintain one dumbbell overhead and walk for a designated distance or amount of time.
